name: hi
description: Hi — a floating AI companion with an animated avatar, a real multi-agent system and shared cloud memory across desktop and Android.

scripts.db:up: docker run --name hi-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=hi -e POSTGRES_DB=hi -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:16 || true
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w desktop
